description:
Controls a funded capability actually touches

The join. A capability, and the controls whose own text concerns it.

Matched against the control's requirement text, never against its title
alone: a title that reads like a familiar control is the most expensive kind
of wrong match. Returns nothing rather than something strained when the
capability finds no purchase, because a join that always finds something is
worthless.

### Responses:

**200**: Successful Response (Success Response)
